notes.title: Patch 1.7 - German, new key bindings & old patches!
notes.content:
To all cube-minded individuals: 

In this latest patch we have added German to the game! We have also made old versions of the game available through the beta system. If you want to very slowly rise to the top in Ascension, this is your patch.

Patch contents:
-The game is now available in German thanks to our friend Grusche.
-The Steam store has been translated to German as well.
-All of the old patches are now available through game branches (see end of post for instructions).
-The keyboard arrows and the "use" key can now be re-binded through the key binding menu.
-The game's version is now displayed in a corner in the main menu.

How to download an older version of the game:

-Right click on the game in your library.
-Click on "Properties"
-Click on the "Betas" tab.
-Select the version you want to download from the drop-down menu.
-Close the properties window and the old version should begin downloading. If it doesn't, close and reopen Steam.

Thank you everyone for playing, we hope you enjoy the patch!

notes.title: Patch 1.6 - French, Norwegian, and V-Sync!
notes.content:
Hello there pupils! We have added two new languages in this new patch: French and Norwegian! We have also added an option to enable V-Sync. Those who have problems with screen tearing can now go to the Graphics menu and enable V-Sync, which should fix most of the tearing issues.

Patch contents:

 The game's text is now available in French thanks to our friend ShomaPlayz Twitch.
 The game has been translated to Norwegian! Thanks to our friend Stian Michael "Stimich" Kjøren.
 The Steam Store is now in both French and Norwegian.
 Added a V-Sync option to the Graphics menu.
 Fixed a sound bug where the lasers would play sounds even when sound was turned off.
 Cubes now have six sides.


Thank you for playing and we hope you enjoy the patch!

notes.title: Patch 1.5 - Ultrawide
notes.content:
Hello everyone! In this latest patch we have enabled ultrawide resolutions, so that people with wider screens can enjoy the game without getting motion sickness. The resolutions can be selected from the Graphics menu. The FOV range has also been increased to accommodate wider screens.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544798/25e135b2747fff5de8b970fe993dc3123603089c.gif

Included in this patch:

 Support for Ultrawide resolutions.
 Increased the FOV range in the Graphics Menu.
 Fixes for UI issues related to ultrawide.
 Removed some typos in the Russian localization.
 Fixed some typos in English localization.
 Lots of sacrifices to the Great Cube.

Thank you for playing, and we hope you enjoy this new GORG dimension!

notes.title: Patch 1.4 is out!
notes.content:
Patch 1.4 is out! In this patch we have added a key binding menu to the game, to help those that were unable to play due to not having a QWERTY keyboard. We have also translated the game to new languages! The patch includes:


 A new key-binding menu where players can choose their own keys for moving, shooting, jumping, etc.
 Italian translation for the game's text, thanks to our friend Simone "Ravel" Garritano. The translation includes all subtitles, menus, and beyond.
 Russian translation thanks to Ihor Ziomkovskyi.
 The Steam store is now available in Italian and Russian as well.
 Some typos in the curator's dialog have been fixed.
 Bug fixes and secret cube improvements.


Thank you everyone for playing, we are extremely grateful to all of you who have given Gravitas a chance! We are very happy to see that people are enjoying the game and we hope you enjoy the patch as well.

notes.title: Patch 1.3
notes.content:
Bug fix:

notes.title: Patch 1.2 is now live! (bug fixes)
notes.content:
We have just updated the game with Patch 1.2! These are the fixes and additions included in the patch:

-Added a "Motion Blur" bar to the graphics menu.
-Broken boxes don't block lasers anymore.
-Level 1's centerpiece speed is not affected by framerate anymore.
-Removed some invisible walls from The End.
-Several UI adjustments, including resizing of some text fields so that they fit in Portuguese and Spanish.
